system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"my awesome daily mix of electronic music that i listened to on the reg has vanished and been replaced by a pop music daily mix, an 80s dm, and a classical music dm. my listening habits havent changed, beyond more acoustic indie. wtf??"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! That sounds frustrating! Can you try logging out, restarting your device, and logging back in to refresh your account? Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Doesn't address the issue of Daily Mix changes."}
